title: Story 2.6 manual outline snapshot
description: This schema checks snapshot shape and field lengths; the API additionally trims titles, rejects control characters and invalid template-section identity, and limits serialized size. PUT /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/documents/{document_id}/outline accepts base_outline_version_id, outline_revision, document_version_id, document_revision, context_version_id, template_version_id and this snapshot. Each section id is stable across manual reorder; manually added sections omit template_section_id or set null. Client input never supplies mandatory. The pinned template manifest supplies template_sections and required_sections with id/title/mandatory; a development fixture without policy makes every fixed structure section mandatory with a deterministic ID. Saving requires current edit authority, draft, exact document head/revision, exact pinned template_version_id and CONTEXT_READY version, validates required IDs and titles, and creates an immutable outline version. POST /confirm accepts version_id plus the exact document_version_id, document_revision, context_version_id and template_version_id and records the current human actor/time. GET /outline, /eligibility, /versions and /versions/{version_id} are no-store and reauthorize the document. OUTLINE_READY is recalculated from the current document, context, template and confirmation; changes invalidate old readiness. Runtime acceptance is not implied.
